Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
So we got a pretty good turnout of 8 players for the Black Hand
prerelease up in Syracuse NY. We played only 2 rounds due to time, but
at theend of the day, the winners were:

1st: Nate Hock, !Tremere 4.5 VPs
2nd: Peter Bakija, !Nosferatu 4 VPs
3rd: Paul, !Toreador 3 VPs
4th: Amy !Malk 1.5 VPs

The new starters seem pretty balanced. I swept a 4 player table with
my !Nosferatu starter (primarily due to Teresita with Shakar and
having 2 Fames...), but then got tooled by the !Malkavians in the
second game.

I'm very pro the new stuff. The new !Nosferatu are freaking
awsome--Teresita is amazing; Tarbaby is certainly reasonable with a
good portrait; Tock is, well, Tock--I like is weird picture. Advanced
Yong Sun is clearly a vampire to build a deck around, but it doesn't
seem that they reprinted regular Yong Sun (anyone get one in a
booster?)

All in all, we were all very pleased with the set, and the tournament
ran very well. Thanks to Nate for running the event, and thanks to
Altered States in The Great Northern Mall for hosting us!

-Peter

Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
pd...@lightlink.com (Peter D Bakija) wrote in message news:<aadbb36b.03111...@posting.google.com>...

>
> I'm very pro the new stuff. The new !Nosferatu are freaking
> awsome--Teresita is amazing; Tarbaby is certainly reasonable with a
> good portrait; Tock is, well, Tock--I like is weird picture. Advanced
> Yong Sun is clearly a vampire to build a deck around, but it doesn't
> seem that they reprinted regular Yong Sun (anyone get one in a
> booster?)
>

I played the !Nosferatu as well, and was happy with their combat
ability. They had only about enough intercept (even after packing it
with all I could from the draft) to survive against the !Malkavians,
but Shakar and Beast, plus 5 Ambushes, did the trick. The !Toreador
were hardly any danger at all (with an exception for Miller
Delmardigan), the !Tremere much more so (by lack of any Immortal
Grapples at all).

On the whole, I had most profit out of Kendrick during the tournament;
Beast's lack of superior Animalism and inability to play action cards
was a big hindrance. In the final, my crypt brought up all the big
guys (Kendrick, Teresita, Cailean and Calebos), but Cailean's so
good... You know, you wait for an Ambush, then play those 3 or 4
Thrown Sewer Lids from your hand.

So popular were they, though, that I had to contest both Kendrick and
Beast, the latter twice, during the prelimenaries. Ah well, at least
the clan has a good starter, and a fun one to play. Kudos to LSJ.

I also noted that the !Nossies have excellent standing votes, and with
the new Animal Magnetism, I see them doing quite as well as their
Camarilla counterparts in the political arena.

Regards,

Patrick
Columbus, OH
